dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's rest time now, right? Why can't I get to sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Wait, no! That was it — we have something important to do in a minute, right...? Yeah, I can't sleep now!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ugh, but if I'm not well-rested when we head off, I'm gonna mess things up for sure. I really don't know what to do...
